title: Stocks Climb as Oil Pares Gain on Iran Deal Hopes
gist: A short CNAS/Bloomberg Surveillance clip has Becca Wasser discuss U.S. missile stockpiles, the Iran war, and a possible timeline for replenishing depleted munitions supplies.

insights.claim: Becca Wasser, an adjunct senior fellow at CNAS, discussed U.S. missile stockpiles, the Iran war, and a possible timeline for replenishing depleted supplies on Bloomberg Surveillance.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: Flags an expert-level discussion of munitions replenishment timelines, relevant for tracking defense-industrial (missile and munitions manufacturer) capacity and order-backlog signals.
insights.locator: Becca Wasser, an adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, joins Bloomberg Surveillance
